# A method on a user type that writes a top-level var compiles, and the write
# lands.
#
# The CLI's harness rather than a golden because the claim is that the
# generated Go *compiles and runs*; testdata/type_method_reads_state.txtar
# holds the shape it comes out in.

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

var log string = ""

struct Calc {
    base int
}

func Calc.pending(k Calc) int {
    log = log + "!"
    return k.base * 2
}

func Calc.doubled(k Calc) => k.pending() * 2

func viaCalc(k Calc) => k.doubled() + 1

component main node {
    var calc Calc = {base=3}
    var out = 0
    var note = ""

    effect(@mount {
        out = viaCalc(calc)
        note = log
    })

    text(value="{out}{note}")
}

func testTypeMethodWritesTopLevelVar(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.out == 13)
    t.assert(c.note == "!")
}

window {
    main
}
